correctness.rationale: All-positive extension iff every face has even unused boundary-vertex count; one-negative forcing excludes any chord with zero free vertices on both neighboring faces; local cyclic shifts in convex faces of at least four vertices avoid all forbidden edges; two-vertex faces contain no forbidden edge. The online predictor makes at most n-1 mistakes. Every extremal chord cuts off an empty leaf face, yielding n^2 supports. All finite checks were run from standalone source; they are corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: Complete structural criterion for every edge query support of a natural Catalan concept family; proves sharp all-order static and adaptive dimensions and exactly n^2 maximum supports. Local active-face obstruction is genuinely stricter than noncrossing all-positive compatibility; its necessity and sufficiency give a usable polynomial geometric test. Intermediate finite profiles are evidence, not the sole motivation.
